propositions: Container restart during in-flight code review causes the review-bot to timeout and cast fail-closed LLM-Review -1 vote, blocking automatic recovery
DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS (45s) is insufficient to wait for full review completion (up to ~911s observed), causing premature worker cancellation and corrupted review shutdown

Coverage-gap decisions with retryable reasons (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) should defer voting and return vote-less to allow backfill reconciler re-drive instead of casting fail-closed -1

Retryable gap conditions accumulate attempt counts per (change_id, revision); after RETRYABLE_GAP_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 3) escalate by casting fail-closed -1 with exhaustion note and emitting VOTER_ERROR marker
Terminal outcomes (finding, indeterminate, gate-disabled) continue to cast fail-closed -1 vote; only retryable infra conditions defer vote-less
Vote-less deferred changes must remain unsubmittable (no LLM-Review vote) and post nothing to Gerrit so backfill reconciler pre-filter does not re-suppress re-drive
